overview.description: The Invesco BulletShares 2036 Corporate Bond ETF (BSCA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market-value-weighted index of USD-denominated, investment grade corporate bonds with effective maturities in 2036. BSCA was launched on Jun 10, 2026 and is issued by Invesco.
